findings.text: Image presents a complete small roof corner, including a free left upturned eave, broad teal roof fan, red post and wall. Guide calls for a much more tightly cropped large gold/orange ridge fragment continuing beyond right and bottom.
The self-contained left eave tip is not supported by this source window. Broad gold mass/trim should continue into the bottom/right crop, not expose a complete roof-and-column silhouette.
Added transverse cut across cream diagonal border is absent as a distinct source joint. Remove the invented strong seam.

sourceObjectLandmarks.note: These are coarse footprint anchors, not a contour mask or sufficient evidence for a spherical finial.

correctionPrompt: Preserve the exact large-scale footprint and crop of the approved original layout guide. This window contains only a tightly cropped, large gold-orange roof-ridge fragment and broad gold/cream trim entering from the right and bottom. Keep the gold highlight around native (950,660), the substantial warm mass along the right-lower area, and the left contour around x760 at y600, x730 at y850 and x690 at y1000. Do not reframe it into a complete roof corner; do not add a free left upturned eave end, a teal tiled roof fan, a red column/wall, or a complete spherical ornament. Keep the original gray stone, cream diagonal border and muted blue-gray ground unchanged in macro placement. Do not introduce a transverse grout cut into the cream border. Render detail within the original footprint; original guide controls all silhouettes.
materialNote: Ground material is relatively quiet; rejection is macro geometry and object occupancy, not a reason to add texture.
